Format 1, revision 2, eighteen cases. MIT OR Apache-2.0; original license files included.
These are authored regression cases, distinct from the pinned W3C test suite.
Manifest validation and syntax parsing alone do not establish entailment execution.
The consumer reports unsupported decisions separately and never counts them as passing.
